The vendor directly providing the software product at **tinypng.com** (TinyPNG / Tinify) is **Tinify B.V.**

### Provider Statement
According to the official **Terms of Service** on **tinypng.com**:
> *"The following terms and conditions (the “Agreement”) govern the use of the TinyPNG and TinyJPG websites and all content and services available at or through the websites (collectively, the “Service”). The Service is owned and operated by Tinify B.V. (“Tinify”)."*

This service is particularly useful for web developers and designers who need to enhance website performance by reducing image load times. It operates globally, serving users looking for efficient image handling solutions.
